description: Build a CapCut/Submagic-style SRT or VTT caption artifact from a caller-supplied word timeline: balanced word groups, sentence-aware breaks, min/max cue durations, optional karaoke word timestamps (VTT), emphasis and speaker markup. Local-only; returns the artifact inline or writes it inside an approved workspace and never changes Premiere.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute existing directory that must contain output_path (checked via realpath of the parent directory). Required with output_path.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

format.description: Artifact format. SRT uses HH:MM:SS,mmm; VTT starts with WEBVTT and uses HH:MM:SS.mmm.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process or one HTTP session) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

karaoke.description: VTT only: emit per-word <HH:MM:SS.mmm> timestamps inside each cue for word-highlight styles. Errors for SRT.

max_chars_per_line.description: Maximum characters per line of plain caption text (default 32); words are never split. Wrapping counts unescaped words only, so VTT escaping, karaoke timestamps, emphasis tags, and speaker prefixes can make the rendered line longer.

max_lines.description: Maximum lines of plain caption text per cue (default 1); markup does not add lines.

merge_gap_seconds.description: Extend a cue to the next cue start when the gap is smaller than this (default 0.3) so captions do not flicker.

min_cue_seconds.description: Minimum cue duration (default 0.5); short cues are extended but never past the next cue start.

output_path.description: Optional absolute file path to write the artifact to. Requires approved_workspace_path; the file must not already exist. When omitted the artifact text is returned inline (up to 512 KiB).

speaker_prefix.description: Prefix cues with the speaker label when present: 'Speaker: ' in SRT, <v Speaker> in VTT.

strip_fillers.description: Tokens removed from the caption text (case-insensitive, punctuation ignored).

items.description: Filler token to drop, e.g. um, uh.

style_preset.description: Style descriptor to return with the artifact (default clean). Documentation only; not encoded in SRT/VTT.

uppercase.description: Render caption text in upper case.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

words_per_cue.description: Target words per cue (default 4); sentences are split into balanced groups of at most this many words.

name: build_caption_artifact

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.
